round: # Story 16: Nasrin and her family (a girl tells it; her small brother answers in the man's voice). Language up to unit 16.

say_en: Hello! My name is Nasrin. I am ten. This is my house.
show_en: Hello! My name is Nasrin. I am ten.

say_en: This is my family. This is my mother, my father and my grandmother. This is my brother, Karim. He is five.
Who is this? This is my grandmother. Point to my grandmother.
wrong_say_fa: این مادرکلان نیست. دوباره ببین و مادرکلان را نشان بده.

say_en: Look! I have two goats and five hens.
show_en: I have two goats and five hens.

say_en: How many hens? Count the hens.
wrong_say_fa: دوباره حساب کن. یک، دو، سه، چهار، پنج. نسرین پنج مرغ دارد.

say_en: f: Karim is sad. Karim, do you like milk? // m: Yes, I do! I like milk.
show_en: Karim, do you like milk? Yes, I do!

say_en: Karim is sad. Give Karim the milk.
wrong_say_fa: این شیر نیست. کریم شیر را خوش دارد. دوباره انتخاب کن.

say_en: f: Here you are, Karim. // m: Thank you, Nasrin! // f: Karim is happy. I love my family. Goodbye!

round: # Story 20: Farid and his grandfather (a boy tells it
picture: man's voice; the questions are asked by the woman's voice). Language up to unit 20.

say_en: m: Hello! My name is Farid. I am eleven. This is my village.
show_en: Hello! My name is Farid. This is my village.

say_en: m: I have a donkey. It is brown. I like my donkey.
show_en: I have a donkey. I like my donkey.

wrong_say_fa: این خر نیست. دوباره ببین و خر را نشان بده.

say_en: m: This is my grandfather. Look! Apples and grapes! // m: I like grapes.
show_en: This is my grandfather. I like grapes.

say_en: f: Farid, give your grandfather the grapes.
wrong_say_fa: این انگور نیست. پدرکلان انگور را خوش دارد. دوباره انتخاب کن.

say_en: m: Here you are, grandfather. // m: Thank you, Farid!
show_en: Here you are, grandfather. Thank you, Farid!

say_en: m: I have apples. // f: How many apples? Count the apples.
wrong_say_fa: دوباره حساب کن. دوازده سیب است.

say_en: m: Twelve apples! I like apples. I like my village. Goodbye!
